test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate homonym.

The **current **situation is tense.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Present**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"current"** has multiple meanings, making it a homonym. Here, it refers to "the present time or situation" (वर्तमान समय).
 
 
• **English Meaning:** Belonging to the time now occurring.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** वर्तमान समय (vartamaan samay).
 
• **Example:** The current state of affairs requires immediate attention.
 
 
• The correct word in the given sentence is **"Present"**, which also means "existing or happening now." (वर्तमान).
 
 
• **English Meaning:** Existing or occurring now.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** वर्तमान (vartamaan).
 
• **Example:** The present situation is tense due to ongoing debates.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate homonym for "current" in the given context is **"Present."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Present**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Running **(चल रहा): In motion or operation.
 
 
• **Example:** The machine is running smoothly without any issues.
 
 

 
• **Electric flow** (विद्युत प्रवाह): Refers to the flow of electric current in a circuit.
 
 
• **Example:** The electric flow in the wires powers the entire building.
 
 

 
• **Modern** (आधुनिक): Relating to the present or recent times.
 
 
• **Example:** Modern technology has transformed the way we live.
